text:
Maria G.: quick heads-up — I'm splitting the shared-egress subnet into two AZ shards (gpu-egress + general-egress) and adding a PrivateLink endpoint service for the model-registry. Pushing branch vpc/egress-shard with tf plan. Can someone eyeball route table assoc + privatelink binding?

Liang W.: pinging — please paste the plan output or a short diff. look for any route deletions or IGW/NAT swaps that could touch prod traffic.

Maria G.: plan snippet below (trimmed):
```
# aws_route_table_association.rta (diff)
-/+ replace aws_route_table_association.rta[1]
  ~ route_table_id: "rtb-aaaa" -> "rtb-bbbb"
  ~ subnet_id: "subnet-1111" -> "subnet-2222"
# aws_eip.nat (create) +1
# aws_nat_gateway.nat_gw (create) +2
# aws_vpc_endpoint_service.model_registry (create) +1
```
Maria G.: TL;DR: re-associating two subnets to new RTBs, creating two NATs (zonal) and an endpoint service with acceptance_required = true. No IGW changes.

Sahil: quick checklist —
- privatelink SG needs to allow LB health port (default our registry uses 8081)
- endpoint service policy: are you restricting principals or using an allowlist?
- NAT creation: watch EIP pool count (we've hit quota before)

Maria G.: SG updated in branch to open 8081 from privatelink SG. For allowlist I'm debating between TF var list vs SSM param. leaning SSM so ops can add partner accounts without tf apply.

Liang W.: SSM is reasonable for operational flexibility. Two notes: document the canonical list in TF (or a data source) so the infra graph shows intended principals, and add a small automation to reconcile SSM -> TF when we want immutability for releases.

infra-bot: deploybot: plan finished for branch vpc/egress-shard — summary: 3 to add, 2 to change, 1 to destroy. CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

Maria G.: thanks infra-bot. @Liang W. if that looks ok I plan to apply during the 23:00 traffic window (low traffic). I'll also annotate the PR with rollback steps for the NAT EIP allocation (if we hit quotas).

Sahil: I'll validate the SG rules and run a quick security-group simulate against the privatelink setup. Give me ~30m.

Liang W.: +1 from me assuming the plan link matches the branch and infra-bot output. Reminder: add a small post-apply smoke test (curl model-registry via privatelink from jump pod) and include it in the PR description.

Maria G.: will add smoke test and PR link in ~10m. thanks all :thumbsup:
